description: P3 consumer-assertion: plugin/governance/definitions.md (Unsafe Git State) defines the safe surface for a wave delegation as the assigned scope UNION the declared wave-sibling scopes passed on the delegation's wave_scopes field. plugin/agents/drone.md and plugin/agents/changeling.md are the named consumers whose git status --porcelain verification bullet applies that union, with its no-field default, and forbids the worker to edit or git-mutate a declared wave-sibling file; each pin spans the union, the default and the prohibition, so dropping any of them fails. plugin/agents/overlord.md is the named consumer that emits the wave_scopes field in ## Delegation Format. Renaming or removing the convention in the definition or either consumer without updating the others is an unprotected coupling.

consumers.pattern: outside the assigned scope plus the declared wave-sibling scopes (`wave_scopes`; absent, the assigned scope only) is blocked per `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/governance/definitions.md` (Unsafe Git State). Declared wave-sibling files are expected-modified; never edit or git-mutate them.
